name: Saitou Masaomi
source:
Akira's best friend.

His personality is like splitting bamboo. He's easily bored and frequently stops doing various things halfway. However, he still has a good personality and is good at taking care of others.

[Translated from [url=http://tennenouji.net/product/01_noten/01char.html]official website[/url]]
